header.title: Privacy Notice
header.subtitle: This notice explains how personal data is processed when you use our website or contact us. We use Cookiebot consent management to ensure compliance with data protection regulations.

controller.title: Controller
controller.name: Jhonathan Campos
controller.note: Until incorporation of a separate legal entity, the controller is the natural person above operating under the trade name "Oversight - Governance Studio".

collection.title: What data we collect
collection.intro: We only process personal data that you actively provide via the contact form or email:

cookies.title: Cookie management and analytics
cookies.intro: We use Cookiebot (by Usercentrics A/S, Denmark) as a consent management platform to control cookies and trackers on our website in compliance with GDPR requirements.
cookies.analytics: With your consent, we use Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager through Google Consent Mode integration. These services only process data when you explicitly consent to statistics and marketing cookies.
cookies.consent: Your consent preferences are stored securely for as long as we rely on your consent for processing. You can change or withdraw your consent at any time using the cookie settings.

purposes.title: Purposes and legal bases
purposes.contactDesc: We process your data solely to respond to your enquiry and manage related correspondence. Legal basis:
purposes.analyticsDesc: When you consent, we process data to understand website performance and user behavior. Legal basis:
purposes.analyticsWithout: Without consent, only anonymous aggregate data is processed under

processors.title: Service providers (processors)
processors.intro: We use the following service providers under GDPR-compliant data processing terms:
processors.cookiebotDesc: Consent management platform that scans, controls cookies, and stores consent preferences (data stored in EU).
processors.brevoDesc: SMTP relay for contact form submissions (email delivery platform based in Paris, France).
processors.googleDesc: Analytics and Tag Manager services (only when you consent to statistics/marketing cookies; operates through Google Consent Mode).
processors.note: Where data is transferred to the United States (e.g., Google LLC, Vercel), transfers rely on the EU–US Data Privacy Framework and/or the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses, as applicable.

retention.title: Storage duration
retention.contact: We retain contact data only as long as necessary to process your request and to comply with statutory retention duties (e.g., German commercial and tax law).
retention.consent: Stored for as long as we rely on your consent for processing, to demonstrate compliance with data protection regulations.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.content: You have the rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, and objection (Arts. 15–21 GDPR). You can change your cookie consent at any time. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.
rights.authorityName: Berliner Beauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit

security.title: Security
security.content: We use TLS/SSL encryption for transport and secure email transmission via Brevo SMTP. Cookiebot processes consent data in secure EU-based data centers. Access to all systems is restricted to authorized personnel only.

changes.title: Changes to this notice
changes.content: We may update this notice to reflect changes in our processing. The latest version is always available on this page.
